visualDirection.heroVisual: A large editorial photograph of the subject with an annotated detail diagram.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Masthead, folios, captions, annotations, and column rhythm.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Print-like surfaces and restrained page transition.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: The annotated image index connects story and evidence.
visualDirection.rationale: The product needs editorial trust and visual explanation.

assetPlan.composition: wide crop with focal point left

visualDirection.heroVisual: A full-bleed scene shows the real product in its natural environment.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Large scene framing, sparse location markers, and high-contrast labels.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Layered depth and short scroll transition with static fallback.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: A route line ties the hero scene to the product proof.
visualDirection.rationale: The surface must sell an experience through scene and proof.

visualDirection.mediaApproach: bespoke illustration and playful graphic marks
visualDirection.heroVisual: A custom explanatory scene shows the product's core mechanism in one memorable image.
visualDirection.graphicLanguage: Cutout silhouettes, labeled arrows, and a multi-color graphic vocabulary.
visualDirection.depthAndMotion: Layered illustration with motion only on interaction.
visualDirection.signatureVisual: The illustrated mechanism is repeated as a small navigation cue.
visualDirection.rationale: The subject benefits from explanation and a recognisable graphic signature.
